item.description:
VIDEO | Delhi: Chief of Army Staff (COAS) General Dhiraj Seth on Monday highlighted the role played by Indian Army's Mission Olympic Wing in supporting talented sportspersons across the country, asserting that their strong performance in the recent Asian Games is an indication of their potential for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

The Indian Army felicitated its medal winners from the continental meet at the Manekshaw Centre here. Army athletes won a total of 20 medals, including six gold, eight silver and six bronze at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.

"I want to assure the nation that, as far as the Army is concerned, we have actively established multiple Sports Nodes across the country through Mission Olympic Wing. We have Boys Sports Companies and Girls Sports Companies. As a regular talent pipeline for every major championship, we will produce new athletes and provide them opportunities to play for the country," Seth said in his address after the felicitation.

STORY | INDIA bloc leaders to file petition against CEC Gyanesh Kumar in SC: Rahul

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Monday said INDIA bloc leaders will march to the Supreme Court and file a petition against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and 'vote chori'.

Addressing a press conference at the Indira Bhawan headquarters of the Congress, he also asked the CEC to turn approver and resign as their fight was against the bigger powers that were behind him.

"Resign, turn approver; you have made a mistake, but you are not the mind behind the mistake," he said.

Noting that there was resistance earlier too, but it had not spilled over the streets in the form of protests, the former Congress president said this fight is not going to stop and will continue even if takes days or years.

item.description:
STORY | Jantar Mantar denotified as protest site, police names three new venues

The Delhi Police has denotified Jantar Mantar as a designated site for protests and named three new spots for holding such demonstrations, according to an official order.

Delhi Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar issued the standing order on October 11, naming Ramlila Maidan, Burari Ground and CBD Ground in east Delhi as the new designated sites for protests and demonstrations.

The move comes amid heightened security arrangements in the national capital following calls to gather for protests at Jantar Mantar.

item.title: A notice issued by Anurag Kumar, Delhi Police Commissioner, reads: "Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, had constituted a Committee to exam...
item.description:
A notice issued by Anurag Kumar, Delhi Police Commissioner, reads:

"Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, had constituted a Committee to examine alternative proper venues for citizen's right for organizing protest/demonstrations in place of the existing "designated site".

Based on the Committee's recommendations, Jantar Mantar as a protest venue has been de-notified. Three new venues viz Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground, East Delhi have been designated as new venues for organizing protest/demonstrations.

Detailed and revised SOP for organizing protest/demonstrations at these three venues will be issued separately. This is in partial modification of earlier Standing Order No. L&O/48/22 dated 28.04.2022."

item.title: RT PIB India: ▪️In a significant step towards strengthening transparency, accountability and patient-centric healthcare delivery, the Union Ministry...
item.description:
RT PIB India
▪️In a significant step towards strengthening transparency, accountability and patient-centric healthcare delivery, the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has urged all States and Union Territories (UTs) to ensure the prominent display of rates charged for services and facilities offered by Clinical Establishments.

▪️Union Health Secretary, in a letter to the Chief Secretaries of all States and UTs, has called for a review of compliance with applicable regulatory provisions and appropriate measures to ensure that information on healthcare service charges is clearly visible and easily accessible to patients and their attendants.

▪️The initiative reinforces the Government of India's commitment to making healthcare delivery more transparent, accountable and responsive to patients' needs, ensuring that access to clear information on healthcare charges becomes an integral part of patient-centric care.

Want to know more? Read here: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2322150
